No: 12146/UIET Date of Advt.: 14-10-24
Advertisement
Applications are invited along with bio-data and attested copies of the certificates of
qualification, experience, etc. for positions of Junior Research Fellow in University Institute of
Engineering and Technology (UIET), Panjab University, Chandigarh under the project titled
“Development of framework/utility for archival, processing, visualization & classification of
seismic signal data for detection of snow avalanche events” sanctioned by DGRE, Chandigarh.
 The position of Junior Research Fellow is for a period of one year and likely to be
extended up to another 12 months OR coterminous with project, depending upon the
satisfactory performance of the candidate.
The incumbents are also expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and may be on holidays also
for any project exigency. The interested candidates need to apply online at Google form link
given below
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeUH8SDmegMesVJHgEzD1b5iALxc0UQpBaw99
IK-jy6lo1MRA/viewform?usp=sf_link
The candidates should apply within 15 days from the date of advertisement.
Junior Research Fellow: 01
Essential Qualifications:
“First class throughout with M.E / M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering / Information
Technology with GATE / UGC NET/PU Ph.D. Entrance test in CSE/IT Qualified and B.E / B.Tech in
Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology”
OR
“B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology with 75% marks and
valid GATE score”.
Desirable: Knowledge of Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence/Signal Processing and willing to
pursue Ph.D. in CSE/IT.
Emoluments per month: Rs. 35,000/-
The date and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the eligible candidates through email or
phone. No separate call letters would be issued for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to the
candidates for attending the interview.
Dr. Neelam Goel
PI and Assistant Professor, IT
UIET, Panjab University, Chandigarh
